experiment: independent fixed-notional conditional directions trained in parallel

definition.objective: OCE power-exp lambda=1: sup_y E[u(y+n*pi)]-y, with one learned real y per independent (n,trading-time) portfolio; after action training each y is solved exactly on the full training half before validation
definition.action: the signed net action is an entry-value dollar portfolio; its L1 norm is strictly below one and one logarithmic barrier is applied to that full vector
definition.notional_independence: every notional has cold-started parameters and no gradient sharing
definition.OCE_validation: the action and training y are frozen on validation; the report also recalibrates one scalar y on each sample set for a proper fixed-action OCE valuation
definition.partition: state-only learned soft router; local direction objectives are summed and physical partition masses are regularized towards equal mass
definition.validation: the entire fitted action is frozen and evaluated on the reciprocal half

source_split_ignored_for_this_experiment.weight_definition: exp(log(p/q)); physical estimates are N^-1 sum_r (p/q)_r f_r

fold.definition: component-stratified reciprocal 50/50 folds; fold 0 trains on the first half and fold 1 trains on the second

portfolio_normalization.definition: calls with K<S are retained; calls with K>=S are replaced at entry by puts through P=C+K-S and dP=dC-dS; spot and option returns are divided by their positive entry prices
portfolio_normalization.cost: one vector barrier B_X(a)=-c X log(1-||a||_1/X), applied to the signed net dollar portfolio rather than coordinatewise

whitening.definition: xi_t=(x_t-m_t) Q_t Lambda_t^{-1/2}; m_t and covariance are estimated on training paths with physical p/q weights

kernel_basis.definition: physical-weighted MiniBatchKMeans centers in orthogonal t6 state; bandwidth is weighted within-center RMS distance

fitted_kernel.definition: physical-weighted K-means initializes z_k and w_k; both are subsequently learned jointly with the local directions

final_oce_translation_calibration.definition: one-dimensional full-training-set solution of E_P[u'(y+n*pi)]=1 after freezing the action

training_set.cross_objective_definition: [direction_notional_index][evaluation_notional_index][time_index]; the scalar OCE translation is recalibrated separately for every evaluation notional and sample set

validation_set.cross_objective_definition: [direction_notional_index][evaluation_notional_index][time_index]; the scalar OCE translation is recalibrated separately for every evaluation notional and sample set
